mechanisms: Long builds left crawling at an empty metal store in the path of the enemy push: coravp_17359 (t4's advanced plant, 177 s at metal 0 with eight builders, killed by the Tigers at 91%), corhlt_7461 (t2's home Warden, 106 s at metal 0, killed at 75%) and corhlt_16044 (t2's Warden under the Quaker shelling, killed at 42%): 2,928 metal (52% of the game's unfinished metal); no hands rule saves these, the lever is the player's spending (fewer frames at once, or a report line giving each frame's time to finish at the current income).

The hands' finished-event match: any finished building of the same type within 250 of a builder's started build is taken as that build (and any frame a builder begins marks its task started), so the builder is moved on or loses its task: coradvsol_13353 (the 12:26 stop at 84%), corllt_26308 (promoted to its queued help at 82%), corsolar_25015 (task dropped, the report said 'finishing an order' until the player stopped it at 83%) and cormex_31095: 510 metal; matching by the frame's unit id would have kept all four.

A queue's leading 'stop' drops the build in progress even when the player wrote it against a walk or a queued step: coradvsol_21260 (237, the stop meant for the queued Guard at spot_49), corsolar_25015 (124, shared with the line above), and the frames begun during the player's own 8-23 s realtime turn before its stop landed (corsolar_27034 42, cormex_22762 20, corllt_31669 12, corsolar_21587 6, corllt_13504 4): 445 metal; a stop that names the build it drops and its share in the result, and leaves a frame begun after the report the player read, would have kept the 237 and shown the rest.
unread: Nothing torn. run/frames.py and run/impedance_sweep.py took --seat for seats 1 and 2; symlink directories for seats 1 and 2 were made in the scratch directory, but the seat 1 and 2 picks were read with a scratch reader of jev-1/jev-2 through run/jevlog.py (the worlds_gate lines, the choice answers and the plan rows) rather than run/hands_window.py, which was run on seat 0. Tool gaps found: frames.py prints no decision rows for the commander in team games (the d rows name it commander_t2/commander_t3/commander_t4, frames.py looks for 'commander'), so the commander's items were read from the record directly; frames.py's never-started list counts an id's helpers and orders the engine placed more than 300 from the ordered point (15 of the 86 orders here, listed as skipped); a frame killed by an unseen enemy reads as 'decayed' (destroyed by nobody): the s rows' dmg field separates them (8 of the 38 'decayed' were kills: corllt_21173, corhlt_16044, corllt_11481, cornanotc_17937 by the bombers, corllt_9958, cormex_2359, corllt_9823, cormex_16194 after its builder died; the two U8 Wardens died to the surrender's self-destruct). Never-started items classified: 41 orders, the costliest of each seat that were not skips (cap 15 a seat); the cheaper extractor orders of seats 0 and 1 and seat 2's 5:18, 10:25 and 13:09 extractor orders were not classified.
